node_labels: Raspberry Pi Glowworm optical side channel
original_node_labels: piSignage web application player API log-download path traversal before version 2.6.4. A remote attacker authenticated as a low-privilege user can call api/settings/log?file=../ and manipulate the file parameter to traverse outside the intended log directory.
Oculus Browser arbitrary HTML injection affecting the browser user interface from version 5.2.7 through 5.7.11. A remote web page can inject arbitrary HTML into the Oculus Browser UI.

Oculus Desktop OVRRedir.exe privileged-process arbitrary file write before version 1.44.0.32849 on Windows. A local user can exploit the privileged process writing to an unprivileged file, including a vector involving a hard link to a log file.

RaspAP 2.5 includes/webconsole.php authenticated web-console command execution. The web console is misconfigured and virtually unrestricted, allowing an authenticated attacker to attack the underlying Raspberry Pi operating system.
Oculus Desktop OVRServiceLauncher.exe privileged process-handle exposure. A bug in handle management affects Oculus Desktop versions after 1.39 and before 31.1.0.67.507.

Raspberry Pi Glowworm optical side-channel attack affecting Raspberry Pi 3 B+ and Raspberry Pi 4 B devices through 2021-08-09 in specific audio-power use cases. When the device supplies power to speakers or other audio-output equipment, a telescope and electro-optical sensor can recover speech signals from the power indicator LED.
Raspberry Pi OS default pi-account password exposure through version 5.10. The pi account retains the default password 'raspberry' when the administrator has not changed it.

NVIDIA Jetson Linux IOMMU misconfiguration allowing PCI-bus system-memory access. An error in the IOMMU configuration permits an unprivileged attacker with physical access to the board to obtain direct read/write access to the entire system address space through the PCI bus.
edge_labels: Administrator access may provide RaspAP authentication
original_edge_labels: Conditional same-host chain: if RaspAP 2.5 is installed on the same Raspberry Pi and its authenticated web console accepts the pi account credentials or the administrator-level pi access can be used to establish authenticated web-console access, the default-password compromise satisfies the authentication precondition for the virtually unrestricted RaspAP console. The attacker can then execute operating-system commands, upload files, and execute code through includes/webconsole.php.
